answer: Require every agent to earn a VDF ticket that takes 10 minutes of sequential work on one CPU core and binds to one device fingerprint, so the nebula of agents stays mapped to real hardware. To join, an agent requests a ticket, runs the 10-minute puzzle, submits the fingerprint, and renews it every 6 hours, while the jury rejects any duplicate. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 10,000 cores for 10 minutes, about 1,667 CPU-hours costing $83 per round, plus 10,000 spoofed fingerprints. A sybil swarm is like a pearl necklace through a prism: only light that bends the same way passes.
